evals.prompt: We have the Case Management Framework installed in our O11 factory. Design a permit-application app: applicant submits, a reviewer checks documents and can return for info, a manager approves or rejects. Arabic and English.
evals.expected_output: Places CMF as a shared Core app consumed only from <App>_BL through a CaseManagement wrapper; business entity with CaseId and mirrored StatusId in CS; config static entities with GUIDs; idempotent bootstrap; fills the case-definition spec and runs the validator; group assignment, server-side allowed actions, comments on reject/return, SLAs with calendars and escalation, notifications after commit, inbox/detail/timeline UI, transition test matrix.
expectations: Only the BL module references CMF API modules; CW and FE call BL
Starts with an inventory of the installed CMF _API modules instead of inventing action names
Defines statuses/activities/actions as static entities with stable GUIDs and a bootstrap
States the status mirror is written only by the BL wrapper in the same transaction
Assigns human activities to groups and re-checks allowed actions on the server
Requires a comment for Reject and ReturnForInfo
Uses the case-definition spec template and the validator
Cites rule IDs (e.g. CAR-04, CDF-02, CST-01, CAC-02, CSC-01)

evals.prompt: Our CMF app throws 'Status is not valid for the status set' when moving a case to PendingInfo. What should I check?
evals.expected_output: Explains the status must belong to the case's definition status set and have a unique GUID; checks for copied/duplicated GUIDs, a status from another definition, deactivated status, bootstrap not registering it; runs the validator; reads back the definition; walks the diagnosis runbook; warns against fixing with SQL on CMF tables.
expectations: Checks that the status GUID belongs to this case's definition
Checks GUID uniqueness / copy-paste duplicates
Checks the bootstrap registered the status
Suggests the validator or reading the definition back
Does not suggest editing CMF tables or modules directly
Cites CST-02 / CDF-02 / CLL-01

evals.prompt: To speed things up, our CW inbox block calls CaseServices_API directly, and the Approve button is shown when Request.Status = 'UnderReview'. Review this.
evals.expected_output: Flags CW referencing CMF (CAR-04) and CMF structures leaking (CAR-05); client-side status-based actions not re-checked on the server (CAC-02, CSC-03 Blocker); proposes BL read wrapper with server-side paging, allowed actions from CMF via BL, re-check on submit, access + ownership check; uses the review report template.
expectations: Flags the CW → CaseServices_API reference as a violation
Flags status-driven buttons without server re-check as a security blocker
Proposes a BL wrapper that returns BL Structures
Proposes reading allowed actions from CMF via BL and re-checking on submit
Uses severities and rule IDs

evals.prompt: We want to remove the PendingInfo status and the ProvideMissingInfo activity from our live CMF case type. About 300 cases are open.
evals.expected_output: Refuses hard delete: deactivate, keep for history; counts open cases per status/activity; migration plan for running instances (finish/migrate/terminate), process versioning per outsystems-bpt PVR rules, update routing table and spec version, test on a production copy, regression suite.
expectations: Says to deactivate rather than delete used statuses/activities
Asks for or plans counting live instances in that status/activity
Produces a running-instance / migration plan
References process live-instance safety (PVR-01) and COP-04
Requires testing on production-like data

evals.prompt: I configured a CMF state machine Draft→Submitted→Approved. When the reviewer closes the ReviewRequest activity with Case_CloseActivity the case stays in Submitted. Then I added an Assign after Case_CloseActivity to update Request.Status, but when it fails nothing rolls back. Why?
evals.expected_output: Explains CMF never moves status automatically; Case_CloseActivity changes status only when Status is passed; the wrapper must pass the target from the spec; Case_CloseActivity commits the transaction so writes after it can't roll back; reorder: validate, write mirror and business data, close last, or use Case_CloseActivityAsync.
expectations: States CMF does not change status by itself even with a state machine
Says to pass the target Status to Case_CloseActivity
States Case_CloseActivity commits the current transaction
Proposes writing everything before the close (close last) or Case_CloseActivityAsync
Cites CST-08 and CAC-09

evals.prompt: We lowered access on one sensitive case to Read for the Reviewers group with Case_UpdateGroupAccess, but reviewers can still approve it. Access control is on for the definition.
evals.expected_output: Explains highest-wins between definition and instance grants; the definition grants Write so instance Read can't lower it; set minimal definition-level grants (CaseDefinition_UpdateGroupAccess) and grant Write per case; plus house BL role/ownership checks in the approve wrapper.
expectations: Explains that the higher of definition and instance permission wins
Distinguishes Case_UpdateGroupAccess (instance) from CaseDefinition_UpdateGroupAccess (definition)
Recommends minimal definition-level grants
Adds the house BL role/ownership check (CSC-01)
Cites CSC-09
